method: Independent read-only source review of pointer_ui implementation. No product edits, builds, tests, UI, real Keychain reads/writes or OS permission/ACL actions by reviewer. Earlier runner implementation is a separate scope.

checks.expected: Owned credential operations serialize and refuse interactive UI without modifying ACL/service identity
checks.observed: All native SecItem call sites found in KeychainStore use shared guard. Guard saves prior interaction policy, disables UI, restores after success/failure; failed restore poisons future calls and best-effort disables interaction. LAContext interactionNotAllowed accompanies queries. Service remains com.astra.mac; no ACL migration/change.

checks.expected: Denied credential access never becomes absent credentials or automatic new sign-in
checks.observed: Only errSecItemNotFound returns nil/false. Read failures propagate typed error. Initial review found server sign-in followed by final-save Keychain failure could repeat on automatic retry. Implementation now wraps final save in IssuedCredentialsNotSaved and pins renewalUncertain; a new three-call regression requires signIn/save once.

checks.expected: Settings initialization does not read secret bytes synchronously on main actor
checks.observed: Shared settings launch detached attribute-only presence reads, coalesce pending task/generation, publish explicit denied state, guard writes while unknown/denied, preserve chosen provider. Settings appearing/becoming active schedules fresh metadata check.

checks.expected: An enabled optional provider can be disabled without reading its key
checks.observed: Initial review found hasKey=false disabled the entire toggle. Corrected disable condition applies only when currently off; regression preserves explicit OFF after presence recovers.

checks.expected: No late dispatch after cancel/edit, or duplicate Home send while connecting
checks.observed: onDisappear cancels connectionTask; helper checks cancellation before/after await; draft plus image IDs must still match. Task ownership blocks another Home send; only submitted clears draft. Unavailable/rejected keep it.
checks.status: PASS (source only; actual GUI not performed)

checks.expected: User can understand and recover missing credential access
checks.observed: Allowlisted connection issue message preserves input; settings emits Keychain guidance and retries attribute check on presentation/active. No direct Keychain Access/recovery route added; OS-side recovery not demonstrated. Gateway reconnect entry remains under connector provider recovery UI.

checks.expected: Asynchronously inserted denial messages remain visible in Settings
checks.observed: Initial source sizes NSWindow once from fittingSize. Settings fixed vertical size has only disclosure resize hook at this checkpoint; late 1-2 keyAccessIssue rows may exceed initial height. Sent owner request to measure denied state or reuse resize hook. No actual clipping asserted without rendering.

limits: Noninteractive Security API behavior on macOS 27 must be confirmed with the actual installed app; mocks do not reproduce OS/keychain-daemon stalls.
Presence success does not prove secret read access; actual use still guards read failure.
Initial-sign-in save failure guard is actor state; no claim of durable cross-restart sign-in idempotency.
No actual Home submission, settings denial recovery, keyboard/IME or repeated GUI click was performed.
No model quality, whole-release or GitHub publication judgment follows from this review.

followUp.method: Read-only inspection of final source and implementer complete round4 log; reviewer did not execute tests or access actual Keychain. Earlier checkpoint retained above.

focusedResult.testKind: fake Keychain policy/readers, settings presence and Home/session unit tests; not OS Keychain or actual UI
focusedResult.exitCodeSource: implementer report; complete log independently inspected

resolved.K2: Final-save error pins renewalUncertain and regression verifies three automatic calls produce only one signIn/save.
resolved.K4: Enabled optional provider can be turned off when key presence denied; recovery does not re-enable it.
resolved.U2: Settings now reuses resizeToContent on both keyAccessIssue changes. Actual late-message layout remains NOT_RUN.

unchangedLimits: Actual installed-app Keychain behavior and recovery UX not established by mocks.
DesktopConnectionBootstrap is a separate later scope, not included in these 47 tests.
